items.title: Fuel Doubled. Five Counterparties Now Decide Which Airlines Absorb It.
items.summary: Jet fuel prices doubled in 2026, and the question for every airline is who captures the margin that remains. Increasingly, the answer sits with counterparties: manufacturers, unions, premium travelers, airports and the banks behind co-brand cards.

items.title: Why Everyone Wants to Give You 10% Back on a Hotel
items.summary: Ten percent back has become a common hotel reward, and what a company can afford to pay depends on what the customer is worth to it after checkout.

items.title: Booking Holdings Plans to Fund New AI Startup Vayo With $100 Million
items.summary: Booking already has tools that organize trips. Vayo's proposition is that AI can turn the itinerary into something more: a system that learns how you travel, watches the entire trip, and starts working before you ask.

items.title: Portugal Picks Lufthansa Over Air France-KLM for TAP Stake
items.summary: Lufthansa gets its gateway to Brazil, but Lisbon still holds the controlling stake – at least for now.

items.title: Phu Quoc is Building Many More Hotel Rooms for a Regional Summit. Some Could Struggle Afterwards
items.summary: Phu Quoc’s peak-season hotel occupancy has surged above 90%, but a massive supply boom will test whether the momentum can last. CBRE says room-night demand must grow about 10% a year through 2030 just to maintain current occupancy — a tougher task after APEC 2027.

items.title: Skift Data + AI Summit Europe 2026: AI Is Ubiquitous, Yet Still Unconquered
items.summary: Under stricter regulation across a fragmented travel market, executives overseeing AI in European travel operations are now being forced into nuanced and challenging conversations.

items.title: Canadian Trips to U.S. Rise for Sixth Straight Month — but Remain Far Below 2024 Levels
items.summary: Six months of growth sounds like momentum until you check the baseline. Climbing out of an unusually soft 2025 isn’t the same as getting back to normal.

items.title: Mumbai Airport Lets Airlines Keep Winter Slots, Delaying the Move to Navi Mumbai
items.summary: A softer timeline gives Adani time to close many gaps. If it doesn’t, summer may bring the same pushback.
